purpose: Qualify ordinary cross-origin PNG image loading under an explicit local Content Security Policy without changing provider or service ownership
baseline: 6c9875f release 0.14.1 plus the current dependency-bootstrap tooling fix
requiredFacts: Reuse canonical retained native URLs and the existing publication/verifier/reference/journal owners
Allowed image origin loads through ordinary anonymous cross-origin img elements under default-src none
Canvas reads match PNG dimensions and original sampled pixels without origin taint
A denied img-src origin emits an enforced policy violation and image error without a provider request
Lost-final-reply recovery still performs no additional upload
Corruption still stops before attestation or the next admission
Reference release refuses new descriptors while saved public URLs and byte liabilities can survive
One test helper owns PNG expectations and local/fetch decoding instead of repeated launcher checks
retention: Retain every attempt/failure, exact sources/binaries/bundles, original profiles/journals/native requests/downloads and browser CSP observations under .tmp/media-csp-01
limitations: Authored PNGs and explicit local fixture policies do not qualify the consumer's assets, transaction or deployed CSP
Image decoding and sampled pixels alone are not independent whole-content verification; native verification remains separate
No deployed provider MIME/CORS/cache/retention, deletion, billing cessation or public access-revocation guarantee
No new product API, provider format, journal, retry owner, paid effect, deployment or sibling edit
